name: Alienware Aurora R12
notes: Unverified: never tried on this machine. Written on 2026-10-16 by alienfx.mjs from alienfx-tools, https://github.com/T-Troll/alienfx-tools, MIT licence, commit 3289c320 (2026-10-14): alienfx-gui/Mappings/devices.csv, each machine's map of its lights.
Its map there: “Alienware Aurora R12”, line 117, device “Chassis”. Which id lights what is that map's; the names are its own, in plain words.
The protocol is verified: the AW-ELC's live preview, as alienware-17-r5-zones.json sends it, which stores nothing in the device.

Matched on the machine (#326): SMBIOS names it “Alienware Aurora R12”, as dmidecode reports it in linuxhw/DMI, https://github.com/linuxhw/DMI (CC BY 4.0), commit 57b21bc6 (2025-01-06): Desktop/Alienware/Aurora/Aurora R12, SKU 0A63.
alienfx-tools does not mark id 1, “Alienhead/Power Button”, as the power button: it is drawn, as the 17 R5's is.
Drawn as the case's front, the lights inside on a side window. Where a light sits is not in the source: it is drawn where its name puts it, the numbered ones in their order around an oval.
